parts.refutation: 'balance lead open' fails. The datasheet's 2-cell unbalance section, C/F version, reads: 'If one of the cell detects the over-discharge, and when the DOUT becomes L, in case that a charger is connected to the battery pack and the other cell detects over-charge, the internal counter will start and after the delay time of over-discharge detector, DOUT will become H.' The pull-down from VC to VSS that P2 relies on makes an open middle wire read as cell2 = 0 V and cell1 = the whole pack, 6.0 V to 8.45 V, above VDET1U 4.290 V: over-discharge on one cell and over-charge on the other. With the USB-C charger connected at V- (where V93 needs it for release), DOUT goes high after tVDET2 (89 ms to 167 ms), COUT goes low, and discharge current flows through the discharge MOSFET and the charge MOSFET's body diode: the pack is not held off. A pull-up in place of the pull-down gives the mirror case. The behaviour with VC left open is not stated. Also: 'pack voltage' quotes 30 V absolute from the features line; the absolute maximum ratings table gives VDD -0.3 V to 12 V, the 30 V being the V- and COUT rating (VDD-30 V). 8.45 V passes, but a 25.2 V mis-connection onto VDD exceeds 12 V
